# Evaluation results (generated by `python scripts/evaluate.py --write`)

Scope: offline deterministic retrieval + extractive answers; not LLM accuracy. 53 questions (45 answerable, 8 unanswerable). Label validation failures: 0.

Questions were drafted with an AI assistant (Claude) from the four curriculum files, not written by students. Labels are checked automatically: each label's evidence keyword must occur on its expected page. This is a development set: the coverage threshold and glossary were chosen while looking at it, so the numbers are optimistic, not held-out. The unanswerable group is small (8 questions).

| System | Hit@1 | Hit@4 | MRR@4 | Evidence keyword@4 | False abstention | Correct abstention |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| legacy_baseline | 64.4% | 91.1% | 0.756 | 88.9% | 2.2% | 37.5% |
| bm25_no_glossary | 66.7% | 88.9% | 0.778 | 88.9% | 6.7% | 100.0% |
| course_compass_v3 | 73.3% | 97.8% | 0.850 | 97.8% | 0.0% | 100.0% |
